features.name: Runtime Response Validation
features.description: docs/plan/response-schema-runtime-validation.md + -tasks.md: RESPONSE_VALIDATION=strict|log|off (default strict outside production, off in production) validates the handler result against the route ResponseSchema before serialization; strict replaces an invalid response with 500 internal_error (WS: status error, data null), log keeps the response and logs a warn without values (sampled, deduplicated, Sentry), off skips the check; responses without a body and middleware-stopped requests are not checked; update documentation/backend
features.evidence: PR #142 (merge 562c38b): RESPONSE_VALIDATION strict|log|off checks the handler result against ResponseSchema before serialization (HTTP any handler status, no-body/middleware/thrown skipped; strict 500 drops handler headers, keeps cookies; WS data null); logs without values, deduplicated, Sentry tag response_validation; found and fixed usage total bigint string; pnpm typecheck/lint/format:check clean, pnpm test backend 1075 frontend 126, test:pg regression, mutation checks, manual crawl in log and strict, docs:build/verify; evidence in progress.md. after review: CI=1 test:e2e 12 passed, invalid response checked manually in strict/log/off, benchmark per mode; follow-ups feat-045..feat-049. Not done: WS routes against a running server

features.name: Response Validation Rollout
features.description: documentation/backend/response-validation.md «Розгортання»: the template has no production, so the rollout is a documented procedure for adopters — strict in dev/CI/e2e, log on staging for ≥ 7 days without mismatch records, log in production, optional production strict after ≥ 14 days without undeclared_key; rollback via RESPONSE_VALIDATION_CONTRACT or the previous backend version
features.evidence: PR chore/response-validation-rollout: «Розгортання» section in documentation/backend/response-validation.md; pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:verify passed. No rollout run: the template has no staging or production

features.name: Strip Undeclared Response Fields
features.description: docs/plan/strip-response-fields-plan.md: ResponseSchema becomes an allow-list of response fields. RESPONSE_VALIDATION is renamed to RESPONSE_VALIDATION_CONTRACT (strict|log, no off, no sampling; old name accepted for one release); a schema mismatch is a 500 in both modes; undeclared keys are a 500 in strict and are stripped with a warn in log; unknown fields carrying DB or user data are detailed, the remaining ones are listed as exceptions without the guarantee
features.evidence: PR #153 (merge 000879c): progress.md Evidence of Completion — typecheck/lint/format/test (backend 1138), e2e 12 passed, docs build/verify, bench:response within §4.7 (+50 % accepted), live crawl in log and strict with 0 response-validation records; T10 staging gate not applicable (template without production), kept as a deployment warning in docs

features.name: Wire-Format Response Schemas
features.description: docs/plan/wire-format-response-schemas-plan.md: response schemas describe the JSON the client receives — no Date or bigint in route schemas (a guard test), values are serialized in transformers (id → String, Date → toISOString), no morphs (the feat-046 fast path stays); push log/statistics and prompt routes get transformers; unused DB-shaped push schemas are removed; non-finite numbers become a 500 in inspectPayload
features.evidence: PR #156 (merge 40d7653): progress.md Evidence of Completion — typecheck/lint/format/test (backend 1153), test:pg 23, e2e 12 passed, docs build/verify, bench:response within the +50 % limit, manual strict check of prompt and push routes

features.name: Uniform WS Error Envelope
features.description: docs/plan/ws-error-envelope-plan.md: every WS transport error (not_found, validation_failed, internal_error incl. a handler that threw after writing data, rate_limited, response validation) has status 'error', data null and the error envelope; one ws-error-envelope module with setWsError replaces three copies of createWsErrorEnvelope; the dispatcher starts with data null; business errors of controllers and middleware stay in data (out of scope)
features.evidence: PR #163 (merge 429416a): progress.md Evidence of Completion — typecheck/lint/format/test (backend 1156), e2e 12 passed, docs build/verify, manual WS check (unknown route and invalid payload answer data null)

features.name: Validate Async WS Messages
features.description: docs/plan/ws-async-message-validation-plan.md: typed registry of broadcast events in shared (5 events), typed broadcastService methods, one runtime createResponseCheck per event before serialization (strict/log as for responses); an invalid event is not sent; frontend keeps ArkType-free guards with a parity test against the registry
features.evidence: PR #167 (aaa265a; #166 merged into the plan branch): typecheck/lint/format/test clean (backend 1174, frontend 168), e2e 12/12, docs build+verify; manual WS check of admin_user_online_upsert in strict/log; progress.md on feat/ws-async-message-validation
